Package com.recruitment.service

Class ApplicationService

java.lang.Object
com.recruitment.service.ApplicationService
public class ApplicationService extends Object
Service layer for TA job applications.

Handles apply, accept, reject, withdraw, and lookup operations. Coordinates with JobService to update filled positions and job status, and with NotificationService to alert module organisers of new applications.

Data is persisted in data/applications.json via JsonUtil. An in-memory list is loaded at construction and written back on each mutating operation.

    • apply

      public Application apply(String jobId, String applicantId, String coverLetter)
      Submits a new application for a job.

      Fails if the applicant already has a non-withdrawn application for the same job. Notifies the job's module organiser via Notification.Type.NEW_APPLICATION.

      Parameters:
      jobId - the target job ID
      applicantId - the applying TA's user ID
      coverLetter - optional cover letter text (may be null)
      Returns:
      the created Application with status Application.Status.PENDING; null if the applicant already applied

      Returns:
      true if found and updated; false if no matching ID exists

    • acceptApplication

      public boolean acceptApplication(String appId, String reviewerId)
      Accepts a pending application and increments the job's filled position count.

      Succeeds only when the application is Application.Status.PENDING, the job is Job.Status.OPEN, and filled positions are below the maximum. Sets the job to Job.Status.FILLED when capacity is reached.

      Parameters:
      appId - the application ID to accept
      reviewerId - the MO user ID performing the review
      Returns:
      true if accepted and persisted; false on invalid state or missing records

    • rejectApplication

      public boolean rejectApplication(String appId, String reviewerId, String note)
      Rejects a pending application and records reviewer notes.
      Parameters:

      reviewerId - the MO user ID performing the review
      note - optional rejection note (may be null)
      Returns:
      true if rejected and persisted; false if not found or not pending

    • withdrawApplication

      public boolean withdrawApplication(String appId)
